items.title: Record Sales Could Be A Turning Point For Carvana Stock (CVNA)
items.summary: Carvana reported record quarterly results, with retail units rising to 197,325 and 217,385 in recent periods. Adjusted EBITDA reached US$769 million, and gross margin stood at 18.9% despite lower gross profit per car. Management attributes current gross profit pressure to factors such as higher reconditioning costs and lower loan rates, which it describes as temporary.
